copy.tagline: 快速配置审批流程与界面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要频繁修改审批提示或展示逻辑
copy.tagline_en: Configure approval prompts and UI quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to frequently modify approval prompts or display logic

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，当你要求添加或修改审批提示或展示工具时，Claude 会保持界面视觉一致性、保留现有的键盘操作逻辑（如Enter/Esc/Shift+Tab），并确保预览渲染快速安全（避免阻塞和性能问题）。
howto.when: 当你要求添加或更改任何审批提示或展示工具时触发。

say.text: 把批准对话框的标题颜色改成蓝色。
在写文件批准提示中添加一个预览区。
让批准选项的选中颜色更明显。

howto.what_en: With this skill, when you ask to add or change an approval prompt or presenter, Claude will maintain visual consistency, preserve existing keyboard shortcuts (Enter/Esc/Shift+Tab), and ensure fast, safe preview rendering without sync I/O or performance issues.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request to add or modify any approval prompt or presenter.

say_en.text: Change the approval dialog title color to blue.
say_en.note: Claude will modify ApprovalHeader.tsx title color.

say_en.text: Add a preview section to the write approval prompt.
Make the approval option selection color more prominent.
say_en.note: Claude will adjust ConfirmMenu.tsx selection styles.
